title: Hardware or software?
instruction: You are putting together a computer for creating with AI. Which of these is hardware and which is software?

items.why: A program and its numbers, stored on a disk.
An app that runs on the computer.
The system is a program too.

items.text: The AI chip in a phone
items.why: A piece of silicon inside the phone.

debrief: You can touch hardware; software runs on it. An AI model is software that needs powerful hardware.
